text:
Sara: NorthBay ops — we'd like to onboard a custom claims summarizer (private deployment). Handles PHI, needs HSM/KMS, dedicated capacity, and safety guardrails. Primary asks: PHI redaction + bias detection. Pilot ETA ~6 weeks. Can someone own?
OnboardBot: Ticket CS-4721 created for onboarding. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onboard (internal).
Devin: @Sara thanks — can you share sample data + a few representative queries? Any latency SLOs we should design for? :eyes:
Ella (NorthBay): Uploading a small sample to the secure intake bucket now. SLO: p95 < 400ms, throughput ~60 req/s. Need audit logging and SOC2-friendly configs. Also some EU residency requirements.
Mike: We'll need an eval set for safety/regression. If you can add ~200 annotated examples with PHI labels + expected redaction outputs that'd be ideal. We'll run OOD and hallucination checks.
Sara: Adding context — renewal risk flagged: if latency or accuracy drops they might not renew. We need clear cost/latency tradeoffs and an enablement plan for their ops team.
Mike: Recommendation: start with a 7B private quantized model + KV caching. We'll compare 7B vs 13B for quality/cost. For strict privacy, use Private with customer-managed KMS + HSM. Note: heavy quantization can affect hallucination rates — will highlight in eval.
Devin: I'll set up an enablement call with Ella and their infra. Proposed slots: Tue 10am PT or Wed 2pm PT. Also planning a canary route + fallback model. I'll own infra-side rollout.
Ella (NorthBay): Tue 10am PT works. Confirming EU data residency for a subset of traffic — need region pinning to eu-west.
Sara: Noted re: EU. @Devin include region pinning and audit log retention. Who will own rollouts and quality gates?
Devin: I'll own the initial canary & rollout policy (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Mike owns eval metrics and quality gate thresholds. Sara will own CS enablement and billing expectations.
OnboardBot: Security intake checklist required before private deploy: 1) sample data uploaded 2) encryption/KMS spec 3) eval plan and safety prompts 4) SLA & audit signoff.
Mike: Action items for ML: I'll prepare an evaluation template (prompt sets, safety tests, redaction matrix) and a model comparison plan. Expect initial results ~10 days after samples are in.
Ella (NorthBay): :thumbsup: Uploading samples now. Can you share a short PHI redaction checklist we can follow?
Sara: Linking PHI redaction doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/phi-redaction (internal). Use "redaction matrix v2" and include entity-level and free-text rules.
Devin: Canary config quick snippet:
```
route {
  weight: 5% -> model: private-7b-q
  fallback: private-3b
  region_pin: ["eu-west", "us-west-2"]
}
```
I'll enable prefix caching and a 5% canary weight to start.
Sara: Thanks team. Looping AE for contract/workflow: will ping Leo about expedited HSM access (renewal risk tied to timeline).
Mike: FYI HSM provisioning timeline is ~2 weeks once contract signed. That could be the critical path.
Ella (NorthBay): On it — I'll escalate to Legal and Procurement.
Sara: :eyes: Tracking in CS tracker. Will post updates in CS-4721. No more blockers for now.
Devin: I'll book the enablement call and add canary task to infra board.
Mike: Will draft eval template today and share in CS-4721.
OnboardBot: Reminder: update ticket with sample link and KMS scope to move to security review.
